name: Electric Last Mile Solutions, Inc.
summary: Electric Last Mile Solutions, Inc. (ELMSQ) was a company dedicated to commercial electric vehicles, primarily engaged in the development, production, and tailoring of electric vans designed for short-distance delivery and utility operations. The firm provided a Class 1 commercial electric vehicle to the U.S. market and intended to manufacture a Class 3 Urban Utility electric vehicle. Based in Troy, Michigan, the company and an associated entity sought Chapter 7 bankruptcy protection, filing for voluntary liquidation with the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware on June 14, 2022.
